title: Black Mountain College Thursday evening at eight o'clock November, 30th, 1939
credit_line: Black Mountain College Collection, gift of Barbara Beate Dreier and Theodore Dreier, Jr. on behalf of all generations of Dreier family
description:
One page, black letterpress on blue paper- printed on one side, folded to fit small envelope.
Black Mountain College
Thursday evening at eight o’clock
November 30th, 1939
MARK WOLLNER
Violinist
Mary Brooks
At the piano
I
Thorarinn Jonsson, Reykiavik
Twyfuga around the name BACH for violin solo; from “Isslandia” (ms.)
II
Cesar Franck
Sonata, allegro ben moderato, allegro, allegro poco moso
III
Milhaud, Szymanowski-Kochanski, Salvator Briarcisee
Sumare, L’Aube (The Dawn), Danca de las Brujas (Witch Dance(ms.))
IV
Godowski-Kreisler, Scott-Kreisler, Paganini-Kreisler
Nocturnal Tangier, Lotus Land, Caprice XX
*handwritten in pencil “The best example for the worst strings we’ve had here- awful! Bob.”
